chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Note lunghimawh kei un. Pasian na um uh hi; kei zong hong um un.
Ka Pa' inn sungah omna mun tampi om hi. Note' ading omna mun bawlkhol dingin va pai ta ding ka hih manin om lo hileh kong gen khin ding hi.
Tua ahih manin kei ka va pai ding a, note' ading mun khat ka bawlkholh khit ciangin keima' omna ah note zong nong om theih nadingun kei hong paikikin note ka kiangah kong la ding hi.
Note in zong ka paina mun a lampi na thei uh hi.”
Thomas in, “Topa aw, na paina mun thei lo ka hih manun a lampi bangci theih ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Kei pen lampi, thumaan thutak leh nuntakna ka hi hi. Kei hong suang lo-in Pa' kiangah kuamah tung theilo hi.
Kei hong thei khin na hih uhleh ka Pa zong a thei khin na hi uh hi. Tu-a kipan amah na thei uh a, zong na mu khinta uh hi,” ci hi.
Philip in, “Topa aw, Pa hong lak in. Tua hileh ka lungkim ding uh hi,” ci hi.

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Philip aw, tu tanta note tawh hong omkhawm khin hilo ka hi hiam? Hinapi, kei hong thei nailo na hi hiam? Kei hong mu peuhmah Pa a mu ahi hi. Bang hangin, ‘Pa hong lak in,’ ci thei na hi hiam?
Pa' sungah kei omin kei' sungah Pa om cih um lo na hi hiam? Note' kianga kong genkhiat thute kei' ut thu tawh hilo a, kei' sunga om Pa in ama' nasep thu a gen ahi hi.
Pa' sungah kei omin kei' sungah Pa om kong cih hong um un. Ahihkeileh zong a lamdang nasepnate hangin um beek un.
“Maantak diktak kong cihin ah kei hong um mi peuhmah keima' septe sem ding a, Pa' kiang kei pai ta ding ka hih manin tuate sangin a lianzaw zong sem lai ding hi.
Tapa' hangin Pa a kipahtawi theih nadingin keima' min suangin nong nget peuhpeuh uh ka sem ding hi.
Na khatpeuh keima' min suangin nong nget uhleh ka sem ding hi.
“Kei nong it uhleh ka thupiaknate na zui ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pa' kiang ka ngen ding a, amah in note tawh hong omkhawm tawntung dingin Huhpa a dang khat hong pia ding hi.

Tua pen thumaan thutak Kha hi a, leitung in amah mu lo leh thei lo ahih manin sang zolo hi. Note na hih uhleh amah na thei uh hi. A hang pen note tawh hong taam bek hilo-in note' sungah hong om ding ahih man hi.
“Note tagah bangin kong nusia kei ding a, note' kiangah kong paikik ding hi.
Tawmvei khit ciangin leitung in kei hong mu nawnlo ding a, ahi zongin note in kei nong mu ding uh hi. Kei nungta ka hih manin note zong na nungta ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin Pa' sungah kei om ka hihlam, kei' sungah note om na hihlam uh, leh note' sungah kei om ka hihlam na thei ding uh hi.
Ka thupiaknate thei-in a zui peuhmah kei hong it ahi hi. Kei hong it mite ka Pa in zong it ding a, ke'n zong itin amau' tungah ka kilang ding hi.”
Tua ciangin Judas (Iscariot ahilo pen) in, “Topa aw, ko tungah kilangin leitung ah kilang lo ding cih pen koici bang ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Mi khatpeuh in kei hong it leh ka thu zui ding a, ka Pa in zong amah it ding hi. Ama' kiangah ko ka pai ding uh a, ka om nading mun uh amah tawh ka bawl ding uh hi.
Kei hong it lo peuhmah in ka thu zui lo hi. Tu-a na zak uh thu pen keima' thu hilo-in kei hong sawlpa Pa' thu ahi hi.
“Note tawh kong omkhop laitak hih thute kong genkhia khinzo hi.
Ahi zongin keima' min tawh ka Pa' hong sawl ding Huhpa ahi Kha Siangtho in note' tungah na khempeuh hong hilh ding a, kong gensa khempeuh hong phawkkiksak ding hi.
Nopna lemna kong nusiat hi. Keima' nopna lemna note kong pia hi. Leitung mite' kipiak danin kong piak hilo hi. Lunghimawh kei unla, zong lau kei un.
‘Ka va pai ding a, kong paikik ding hi,’ kong cih na za uh hi. Kei nong it uhleh na lungdam ding uh hizaw hi. A hang pen Pa' kiangah a va pai ding ka hi a, Pa pen kei sangin lianzaw hi.
Hih thu a pian hun ciangin na up theih nadingun hih thu a pian ma, tu-in note kong gen khinzo hi.
Hih leitung-uk mangpa hong tung ta ding ahih manin note tawh thu tampi ka gen nawnkei ding hi. Amah in kei' tungah thu nei lo ahih hangin
Pa ka itlam leitung in a theih theih nadingin Pa' hong thupiak bang lianin a gamta ka hi hi. Ding un, hih tak pan pai ta ni.”
